lines.text: Many learners say: The peoples are kind.
People! The people here are friendly.

native.tip: “People” zaten çoğuldur, -s almaz: “The people are kind.”
native.caption: “The peoples are kind.” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “people” kelimesine -s eklenmez. Doğrusu “The people are kind.”. Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “people”. People zaten çoğul. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: “People” is already plural and takes no -s: “The people are kind.”
en.caption: Do you say “The peoples are kind.”? 😅 In English you do not add -s to “people”. The right sentence is “The people are kind.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
